help.title: BubOS – command overview
help.tips: Tab completes names, ↑/↓ browse the history, Ctrl+R searches it, Ctrl+C interrupts a command.
nano.noname: No file name – exit and run: nano name.txt
sudo.notallowed: {user} is not in the sudoers file. This incident will be reported.
passwd.deny: You may not view or modify password information for {user}.
mission.none: no mission is running – find missions in the campaign (Campaign button above)
mission.intro: The briefing and goals are in the panel. In the terminal: "mission" = status, "mission hint" = hint.
login.hint: Accounts: student / student (regular user), root / root (administrator)
ui.title: BubOS – Linux teaching simulator
ui.export.title: Save the whole system to a file
ui.import.title: Load a system from a file
ui.reset.title: Delete the sandbox and start over (campaign progress is kept)
ui.reset.type: To confirm, type the word {word} and press OK.
ui.reset.cancelled: The word does not match, nothing was deleted.
ui.reset.confirm: Really delete the whole sandbox and start over? Work in it that was not exported will be lost. Your campaign progress is kept.
ui.import.confirm: Loading a file replaces the current sandbox. Campaign progress is merged with what you already have (stars never go down). Continue?
ui.docs.title: Open the documentation and manual
ui.campaign.title: Missions and challenges rated with stars
ui.sandbox.title: Back to the free sandbox (the mission stays in progress)
panel.restart.confirm: Restart the mission from its initial state? Your work in this mission will be discarded.
panel.done.more: The goals are done. Complete the bonus for the third star, or go back to the campaign.
panel.done.hint: With a hint used it is 1 ⭐. Try the mission again later without hints.
panel.loadfail: The mission could not be loaded.
ui.hint: Tip: Tab completes, ↑/↓ browse the history, Ctrl+R searches it, Ctrl+C interrupts a command. Your work is stored in this browser – use Export to move it.
camp.title: BubOS – campaign
camp.heading: campaign
camp.export.title: Save the sandbox and your campaign progress to a file (backup, moving to another device or sending to a friend)
camp.import.title: Load a file from Export: progress is merged (better results are kept), the sandbox is replaced only after confirmation
camp.intro: Pick any mission that interests you – there is no required order. Every mission runs in its own clean system, so you cannot break anything and your sandbox stays untouched. Completed = ⭐, without hints = ⭐⭐, with the bonus too = ⭐⭐⭐.
camp.known: Already know it? Start the mission and complete it without hints – you get the stars right away.
camp.backup.never: Your progress is not backed up yet. Save it with Export – it survives clearing browser data and moves to another device.
camp.backup.old: Your progress was last backed up {n} days ago. Save a new backup (Export).
camp.import.bad: The file could not be loaded.
camp.loadfail: The missions could not be loaded.
pager.hint: q = quit · space = next page · b = back · ↑/↓ = scroll
editor.title: BubOS nano
editor.ask: Save modified buffer? Y = yes, N = no, Esc = cancel
live.hint: q or Esc = quit, the content refreshes by itself

# Cron jobs. One line = one job:
# minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week command

# * * * * * date >> ~/cron.log
camp.reset.title: Delete campaign progress and unfinished missions (the sandbox is kept)
camp.reset.confirm: Really delete all campaign progress (stars and unfinished missions)? The sandbox is not changed. To keep your progress, export it first.
camp.import.confirm: The file also contains a whole sandbox and loading it replaces the current one. Campaign progress is merged with what you already have. Continue?
ui.import.progressonly: The file contains only campaign progress. The progress was loaded (merged), the sandbox was not changed.
